protocol: HWSU-DESIGN-v1 (design freeze; phase 1 = the oracle-only stage OF)
status: CONTRACT_OF (written before any module code; the protocol wins on conflict)
precedence: PROTOCOL_HWSU_v1.md > CONTRACT_OF.json > API.md > TEST_PLAN.md; a difference is a contract defect to report, never to resolve in code
number_format: Exact values are strings parsed by fractions.Fraction(str); integers are JSON ints; floats are tolerances or report-only copies
loader: hwsu_config.load_contract: this file plus an optional tools/hwsu/CONTRACT.json that must carry contract_of_sha256 = sha256 of this file's bytes; recursive dict union; any duplicate leaf key -> FAIL_TECHNICAL/BINDING (API.md §1.2, D-2)

authority.run_approval: AUTH_OF_<job>.json in hwsu-store binds the owner's OF approval file (path relative to the mailbox, sha256) and the sha256 of FREEZE_OF.json; written by the coordinator after the owner's approval (D-23)
authority.not_authorised: addendum 37: no run of track U, OF included, without an explicit owner run approval

handoff.rule: read only by hwsu_config.load_handoff_u (sha256 check; two keys); hwsc_config.load_handoff is never called (D-4)

world.build: hwsb_data.build_process(ArtifactStore(MemoryBackend()), masters=(620301, 620302, 620303)); identity by hwsc_data.process_identity (stage C's world block); nothing is written to disk
world.emission_meta_rule: hwsc-store/artifacts/EmissionSpec/<id>/meta.json exists with artifact_type EmissionSpec and config.replicate == master; WorldSpec and TransitionSpec meta.json exist with their artifact_type (D-11)

stage_c.phase1_never: no payload.npz, state.pt, HIST_*, sealed/, chart, activation, registry digest file; hwsc_records.lineage_c is not run in OF (D-11)

namespace.rule: OF-0: the record's tracks.U must equal namespace.U exactly; any U/D token overlap -> FAIL_TECHNICAL/SEED_SCOPE (D-16)

uses.640102: OF-1 KO categories and OF-3 bounds and psi_orc interval (two separate calls)

streams.arm2_order: n uniforms for z_28; then for t = 28..1: n emission uniforms, then (t > 1) n transition uniforms (API.md §2.2)
streams.bootstrap: c1_means.bootstrap_means / c2_decide.stream_bounds: PCG64(seed), one shared index stream per call

sequence_ids.order: rows in arm-1 sequence-id order (increasing index); arm 2 row i pairs with arm 1 row i; arm-2 ids never sorted (S2)

thresholds.guard: c2_decide.guard (GUARD_REL 1e-9) with beta_A from GLS-REF delta_P for OF-3

on_failure.OF-3: degenerate fit FAIL_TECHNICAL/NUMERICAL; bound -> SHARE_DROPPED (share outcome INCONCLUSIVE/ORACLE_FEASIBILITY)
on_failure.OF-4: response arrays INCONCLUSIVE/ORACLE_FEASIBILITY; share arrays only SHARE_DROPPED

blindness.stage_c_list: hwsc_config.blinded (stage-B files of stage C's list)
added: hwsd-store/** except REGISTRY_OBLIGATION*.json, RESERVATION*.json, reservations/, reservations/*.json (J9)

g0.label: hwsu_declaration
g0.rule: hwsu_seed.seed_search_u (mirror of hwsc_known.seed_search_c; whole-token rule for digit needles; blinded paths pruned before any open by hwsu_config.blinded) then hwsu_seed.classify_hits_u; any unclassified hit -> FAIL_TECHNICAL/SEED_SCOPE

phase1.write_rule: hwsu_records.save_array refuses any other array name (FAIL_TECHNICAL/LINEAGE)

obligation.j11: joint ruling J11 (addendum 4), field for field for both tracks

basis_meaning.artifact: WorldSpec/TransitionSpec/EmissionSpec/Checkpoint payload classed by sibling meta.json (J10 1 i)
basis_meaning.registry: relpath with a component named registry before the file name (J10 1 ii)
basis_meaning.name_rule: a name_rules regex fullmatches the relpath (J10 1 iii)

obligation.sha256_null_only: Checkpoint payload (state.pt / payload.npz under artifacts/Checkpoint/), never opened or hashed
obligation.reader_rule: newest by written_utc governs; missing/extra key, unknown value, unlisted array file, sha256 mismatch (non-null), or a name_rule basis no regex matches -> INCONCLUSIVE/REGISTRY_INCOMPLETE

reservations.attestation: hwsu_records.w2_attestation: <root>/*/RESERVATION*.json and <root>/*/reservations/*.json (END records excluded); ACTIVE iff state == ACTIVE; ended iff rule (a) RES-HWSC-W2 with HWSC_W2_END.json bound, or rule (b) a matching hws-reservation-end-v1 record

store_layout.also_exempt: k4b_release.RECORD_FILES; reservations/*.json; logs/, operations/, tmp/, tmp-*/; superseded/ (SHA256SUMS)
stage_events: OF_S (BEGIN, STAGE_COMPLETE: the six history tables)
store_layout.dry_store: X:/Downloads/topo-scratch/hwsu-dry-of (or hwsu-dry-of-<job>); DRYHIST_OF_* names; stages/DRY/DRY_OF_REPORT.json; REGISTRY_OBLIGATION.json

study_ledger.labels: unique per attempt: J-OF-<job>-a<k>, DRO-<job>-a<k>, OF-<job>-a<k>

of_b.rule: git diff --no-renames --name-status r_ref h_exec: every line allowed; reuse_sha256 equal at r_ref, h_exec and in the working tree; hwsu_bind.audit PASS; verify_freeze_of PASS; else INVALID

cpu.policy: measure-only (--max-cpu inf --max-wall inf); centrals are forecasts, never caps
cpu.re_set: after measured J-OF/DRO/OF cost (cost only; addendum 26 item 2)

resources.footprint: no .npz/.npy committed under tools/hwsu or tests/hwsu; implementation, tests and the dry run write no array file under the project root

dry_run.never: a real store, real root files, a real checkpoint, a registered scope, HIST_* names

binding.rule: phase-1 code references reused code only as <module>.<name> pairs listed in allowlist (or external_ok modules, or from_imports); never a never_called name; every allowlisted tools function's transitive call-time reads equal its call_time_reads (AST audit, hwsu_bind)

call_time_reads.hwsb_config.EMIS_CFG: EmissionConfig(mode='overlap', V=36, sigma=1.75, center_strategy='grid', source_mode=None, metric='flat')

call_time_reads.k4b_data.PREDICATE_REASON: potential overlap with sealed D-2a histories

binding.allowlist_note: call_time_reads: the transitive module-level non-callable names read by the function (tools/ functions only, D-25), with their values at e3710d2 import time; meter/controls/winjob names under k4b_meter_bind are bind targets, not configuration reads

conditional_reads.why: only when fragments/job_scratch are None; HWSU always passes both
default of masters; HWSU always passes masters

forbidden_reads: CONTRACT[<other than the HWSC world block>]
binding.permitted_reads: shape constants and the owner-approved C2/C2ND thresholds and tolerances listed under call_time_reads (e.g. c2_config.COND_MAX, LW_RATIO, SV_RATIO, T_GLS_ID, GLSREF_RHO, GLSREF_PROJ, GUARD_REL, ZERO_MOD, N_NUIS, DESC_ALPHA), c1_oracle.A_H3, k4b_data predicates, hwsc_config.CONTRACT["world"]

reuse_sha256_note: sha256 of the git blob bytes at e3710d2 of every repository file in the import closure of the allowlist (and the CONTRACT.json beside each), as imported with hwsu_config's sys.path order

root_rule.listing: name-only; no file opened, no array header read

hygiene.rule: after each implementation or dry job, hwsu_records.root_inventory(root) shows no new array file, protected name or ObservationSet root (§8.4)

to_freeze: binding.allowlist call_time_reads and reuse_sha256 (re-run the audit at h_exec)
of_b.r_ref and phase1_files (if a module is split by size)
